subject: W4-A Task 2 Canonical Reservation Lifecycle Authority

results.suite: W4-A Task 2: Canonical Reservation Lifecycle Authority
invariantsVerified: 1. Lifecycle worker direct GUC forgery -> denied fail-closed (GPT-6 reproduced defect resolved; GUC is not authority root)
2. Lifecycle worker direct caller-principal forgery -> denied fail-closed without valid authorization
3. Lifecycle worker arbitrary capability/authority ID -> denied fail-closed with LIFECYCLE_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND
4. Lifecycle worker cannot issue authority (PostgreSQL permission denied 42501 on routine and table)
5. Valid authenticated Guest authority + own ENCHO_DIRECT reservation -> accepted (CANCELLATION_REQUESTED, sequence 1, replayed=false)
6. Foreign Guest authority -> denied fail-closed with LIFECYCLE_FORBIDDEN on issuance and LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_CONFLICT on mismatched consumption
7. Authority/reservation mismatch -> denied fail-closed with LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_CONFLICT
8. Authority/command semantic mismatch -> denied fail-closed with LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_CONFLICT
9. EXTERNAL_CHANNEL reservation -> denied fail-closed with LIFECYCLE_ORIGIN_NOT_SUPPORTED on issuance and consumption (GPT-6 reproduced defect resolved)
10. Guest tries to submit origin_kind = EXTERNAL_CHANNEL -> denied by schema validation with LIFECYCLE_ORIGIN_NOT_SUPPORTED
11. Exact committed replay by same authenticated Guest -> recovers same authorization and event with replayed=true
12. Unauthorized presentation of another command ID -> denied fail-closed with LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_CONFLICT
13. Same command ID + changed reason semantics -> fails closed with LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_CONFLICT
14. Concurrent use of same valid authority -> serializes safely, one original and one replayed=true, exactly one event row
15. Concurrent different commands for same ACTIVE -> CANCELLATION_REQUESTED -> serializes safely, one succeeds, one conflicts with LIFECYCLE_STATE_CONFLICT
16. Lifecycle event, command receipt, and authorization consumption remain atomic in single PostgreSQL transaction
17. Authorization cannot be mutated after issuance (immutability trigger rejects UPDATE of issuance fields and DELETE)
18. Raw web, public, and other worker roles cannot issue authority (permission denied 42501)
19. Canonical reservation with zero events projects initial derived state ACTIVE (sequence 0, latestEventId null)
20. W3 reservation row remains immutable: status = 'INVENTORY_COMMITTED' is untouched allocation truth
21. inventory_days.booked_units and held_units remain completely unchanged after CANCELLATION_REQUESTED (zero inventory side effects)
22. Zero payment rows, ledger updates, gateway calls, or refund obligations are created (zero refund side effects; refunds deferred to W4-D)
23. Raw Guest/web role (encho_stays_web) cannot INSERT or UPDATE lifecycle events, commands, or authorizations
24. Direct UPDATE or DELETE on canonical_reservation_events is rejected by trigger with CANONICAL_RESERVATION_EVENT_IMMUTABLE
25. Legacy bookings.status mutations do not alter canonical reservation lifecycle projection
26. No public completed-cancellation API or CANCELLED status transition is added; inventory release deferred to W4-B
27. Role boundary enforcement: worker cannot issue, issuer cannot transition, raw web cannot do either
28. assertLifecycleWorkerRole and assertLifecycleIssuerRole reject broadened or non-restricted roles with LIFECYCLE_ROLE_NOT_RESTRICTED
29. Worker authorization enumeration denied -> direct table SELECT on authorizations rejected with 42501
30. Concurrent identical issuance -> both succeed with same authorization ID -> exactly one durable row (idempotent serialization via FOR UPDATE on reservation)
31. Concurrent same command with changed semantics race -> one succeeds, second receives LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_CONFLICT (no 23505, no silent replacement)
32. Failure-injection atomicity -> consumption failure rolls back event, command receipt, and authorization consumption cleanly
33. Unused expired capability -> rejected with LIFECYCLE_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED
34. Exact replay after capability expiry -> succeeds and returns original event with replayed=true (expiry blocks new use only)

authorityBoundaries.authenticationRoot: trusted application/session tier, NOT proven/mounted in this W4-A worker batch
authorityBoundaries.authenticatedGuestIngress: NOT IMPLEMENTED / NOT MOUNTED IN W4-A
authorityBoundaries.issuerStatus: internal authority primitive; trusts authenticatedPrincipal supplied by calling application tier
authorityBoundaries.workerAuthorizationTableAccess: DENIED (PostgreSQL permission denied 42501; cannot SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE directly)
authorityBoundaries.issuanceConcurrency: idempotent under independent issuer connections; serializes on canonical_reservations FOR UPDATE row lock before inspection and insert
authorityBoundaries.authorizationMutability: immutable issuance fields + one monotonic consumption transition (UNCONSUMED -> CONSUMED exactly once)
authorityBoundaries.rollbackProof: failure injection proven via owner trigger raising during consumption UPDATE; verifies full atomicity and rollback of events, commands, and authorization consumption

encho_lifecycle_issuer.type: Restricted role (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION)
encho_lifecycle_issuer.privileges: EXECUTE ON FUNCTION canonical_issue_cancellation_authorization only; zero table DML; zero transition execute

encho_lifecycle_worker.type: Restricted role (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION)
encho_lifecycle_worker.privileges: EXECUTE ON FUNCTION canonical_request_reservation_cancellation and canonical_get_reservation_lifecycle only; zero table DML; zero direct table SELECT; zero capability issuance

encho_stays_web.privileges: Zero access to lifecycle procedures or lifecycle tables

eventModel.immutability: Append-only; trigger raises CANONICAL_RESERVATION_EVENT_IMMUTABLE on UPDATE or DELETE

commandAuthority.immutability: Committed receipts reject UPDATE or DELETE with CANONICAL_LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_IMMUTABLE

concurrency: Row-level lock on canonical_reservations (FOR UPDATE) serializes both issuance and transition execution per reservation; lock ordering is strictly canonical_reservations FOR UPDATE -> canonical_reservation_lifecycle_authorizations FOR UPDATE

lifecycleProjection.requestedState: CANCELLATION_REQUESTED when latest event is CANCELLATION_REQUESTED

zeroInventorySideEffect: inventory_days.booked_units is not decremented; physical allocation remains intact
zeroRefundSideEffect: canonical_payment_attempts, canonical_payment_reconciliations, and gateway balances are untouched; zero refund rows created
limitations: No completed cancellation (CANCELLED) is implemented; no inventory is released (deferred to W4-B); no reservation modification is implemented (deferred to W4-C); no refund or payment ledger updates are implemented (deferred to W4-D); public checkout remains disabled; production payable authority issuer remains legally gated.
